steps.name: The Ultimate Dessert (1)
steps.objective: Talk to [Io] in 「Gerda」, then find [Jelic] in 「Guild Union City Esnil」.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What's this? How did you find it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I talked to Madeleine like you suggested, then went to the Echo Spring and found it there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I gave one to Madeleine, then went back for another to bring to you.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's been so long since I last saw one in person... Not since I was a child...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a gift. Madeleine wanted you to have it. So did I.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh... Thank you.
(Io smiles softly, and the ice in her hand melts.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It's a Deborah Snowflower. More precisely, an Eternal Snowflake. A flower encased in ice, eternal hope and endless comfort...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It must have been near where Echo was.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...I gave it to her when she was feeling anxious.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Anyway, thank you. Let's make sure we protect this hope and comfort.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, let's. Together! But didn't you say you were going to rest?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I did. I wanted a few days without a thought in my head, but that doesn't seem likely.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is something wrong?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Nothing's wrong... I just want something delicious to eat.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Not that Galette's cooking isn't delicious. I just want something different...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Some people used to leave cakes and things and run away, but I haven't seen much of them lately...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: You know them too, right? The ones in black.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They do give me piles of food every time I visit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'd like Galette to learn how to make their food. Could I ask you to help?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. It's a favor for you, after all.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you. If you find anything out, go straight to Galette. No need to come back to me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. See you later, Io.

steps.name: The Ultimate Dessert (2)
steps.objective: Obtain <Mint Chocolate Cream Bread> in 「Magic Academy Main Building」. Then talk to [Galette] in 「Gerda」.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hello, Adventurer. Would you like sweet potato mousse cake, tiramisu, or cheesecake? We have carrot cake too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait a moment. You're offering me all this already...?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hehehe. I haven't had the chance to feed you lately, so I'm making up for it!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Let me know if it's not enough!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't think that will be a problem!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: That's a little disappointing... What brings you here, though? I doubt you came of your own accord to eat cakes and desserts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Jelic that Io is looking for a new dessert.)

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Oh, she has excellent taste. A new dessert... All those cake boxes I left at the village entrance like Santa Claus paid off!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: The snowfield's special snow and ice kept them fresh.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Just how far do you travel to hand out desserts?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Apart from places people can't normally reach, like the Demon Realm, I think we've covered almost everywhere.
(Jelic looks proud.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impressive.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I recently made a bread tailored to the tastes of the students at Xerenis Magic Academy. That should do nicely!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Jelic.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: I'll give you the recipe, but on one condition.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A condition?

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: You'll need to taste it first. It's supplied exclusively to the Xerenis Magic Academy shop, so you'll have to get some there yourself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. I'll go get a few.

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: To feed everyone in Gerda, you'll need at least fifty, right? The students should have plenty stashed away. Find fifty and take them with you! That's my condition!

lines.speaker: 젤릭
lines.text: Hehehe! Now, I'm busy, so I'd better get back to work.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like a food delivery worker... What kind of bread is it, anyway?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: I smelled something delicious and came to investigate. You've brought quite a lot, %s. Io has been looking forward to it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...It's popular with students, so I don't know if you'll like it.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Io says she'll happily eat anything, but this you've brought, %s...
(Galette takes a bite of a Mint Chocolate Cream Bread.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: The distinctive, smooth mint cream mingling with rich, sweet chocolate cream... This flavor is unmistakably...

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Yes, bread from another continent.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: It certainly isn't to my taste, but I think the people of Gerda will find it a refreshing change.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you think so?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: If I get the chance, I'd like to invite the person who left all those cake boxes at the village entrance.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: How does anyone come up with food like this?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm sure you'll have a chance someday. Oh, what's that...?

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Ah, Madeleine asked me to hang that frame in the shop. It's a snow flower. Beautiful, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That flower... I see. I'll have a look around elsewhere, then. See you later.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Come back for a meal sometime, %s. Hmm, no customers. Perhaps I'll take a walk...

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Of course, the moment I say that, a customer arrives.

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Welcome! I'm Galette, proprietor of the Snowflower Inn, a blossom upon the sparkling snow. Is this your first visit to the village?
(A woman approaches Galette. She appears dressed as a monk, yet carries a sword, creating a curious impression.)

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Miss? Is something the matter?

lines.speaker: 여성 수도사
lines.text: Oh, n-no. I have a weakness for handsome men... Ah! Never mind. Io told me to ask you about a room...

lines.speaker: 갈렛
lines.text: Haha, I see. May I have your name for the guest register?

lines.speaker: 렌
lines.text: I-I'm! R-Ren! My name is Ren!
